answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, like a sparrow that must leave a feather at the gate of the meadow before entering. If a grading jury later proves the identity fake, the stake is slashed and paid to honest graders. A single fake then costs its deposit, while a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits, so the attacker's pulse of new identities bleeds money faster than honest work can repay it.
